_about: Cards drafted from each tool's own contract (tools/tool_card_author.py, reviewed).

orchestration.execute_envelope.use_when: The person wants a clearly scoped job carried out in their current project by a coordinating, coding, or checking agent, rather than just advice or text about it.
examples: Have the coder agent implement the task we just scoped out
run teh verifier on what i just changed
Please kick off the coordinator to split up this refactor and start it
get the coder to do the login fix, only that part, nothing else
can you run the checker agent over my latest changes and tell me if they pass
start the planner job for the migration we described
go ahead and execute that task plan in my project
verifier pass on the current branch pls
Could you please send this bounded job to the coding agent and run it?
run the approved task now, coder role
Pon al agente programador a implementar la tarea que preparamos.
Lance l'agent vérificateur sur mes dernières modifications s'il te plaît.
